question: What claim is being made here about the status of this secret and the condition under which it has been revealed?
premises: Among secrets, this is the supreme secret.
It has been revealed to you.
It has been revealed by means of devotion.
inference: The supreme secret among secrets has been revealed to you by devotion.
uncertainties: The agent of revelation is not named in this verse.
plain_english: The supreme secret among secrets has been revealed to you by devotion.
